description: This source file defines locale-specific (Canadian English) date and time formatting information and extends the Date object with culture-based methods for date manipulation, parsing, and formatting.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Stores locale-specific date and time formatting details for en-CA (English - Canada).

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets time components (hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds) of the Date object to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current system time.
